name: Traumatized Mr. Incredible
look: Two panels side by side. Left: a 3D render of Mr. Incredible in full color, smiling contentedly against a gray background. Right: the same face in grainy black and white with deep shadowed eyes and a strained, haunted grin.
use: Contrasts innocence with disturbing knowledge. The left side is people who don't know a fact and the right side is people who do, so the caption pairs a harmless topic with its creepy or depressing truth.
slots: people who know the unsettling truth (right, haunted)
examples: People who don't know how hot dogs are made
People who know how hot dogs are made
describe: mr incredible happy on one side and creepy dark on the other
cartoon dad smiling then a black and white traumatized face
pixar superhero normal next to a haunted uncanny version
smiling animated man beside a scary shadowy copy of himself
people who know vs people who don't with mr incredible
origin: Uses Mr. Incredible from Pixar's The Incredibles films, with the right side edited to look haunted.
